# Provenance Streams

> An autonomous USDC settlement engine on Circle's Arc chain. An auditor attests to a supplier meeting a requirement, AI and on-chain checks review the evidence, and the supplier is paid automatically — no human in the loop for the normal case.

Provenance Streams records auditor-signed attestations on-chain, evaluates them against configurable reward policies, runs independent signature verification and AI-assisted fraud scoring, and settles real USDC payouts (same-chain on Arc, or bridged cross-chain via CCTP) from a treasury wallet — with high-risk payouts held for human review instead of blocked outright.

## Roles

- Auditor: submits attestations on a supplier's behalf.
- Supplier: receives USDC rewards once an attestation clears policy, signature, and fraud checks.
- Admin: reviews flagged payouts and monitors settlement/bridge activity.

## Docs

- /how-it-works — plain-language walkthrough of the attest → verify → settle flow.
